name: size_georgia_10
paragraphs: The kettle on the far shelf had been whistling for a while before anyone noticed it. Marta lifted it off the heat and poured two cups without asking. Outside the rain had finally stopped and the street lamps were coming on one by one along the wet road.
notes: Georgia 10px / 배경 plain. 폰트축: 세리프 본문 + 올드스타일 숫자. 부분 오독 (실측 CER 10.67%)
